safety.meta_daily_budget_delivery_note: Meta treats a daily budget as an average and may spend up to 75 percent above it on a given day while limiting a week to seven times the daily setting.

apple_campaign_links.group_reporting_policy: Use the aggregate groups token for every approved group placement during the pilot; do not create per-group tokens until expected volume can clear Apple's reporting threshold.

small_market_delivery_plan.market_context: Approximately 1,200 total academy students; parent and family prospects are geographically dispersed and the directly relevant paid audience is small.
small_market_delivery_plan.initial_structure: Use one cold ad set only so the limited budget is not fragmented. Keep warm and partner ad sets PAUSED until their gates pass.
small_market_delivery_plan.audience_policy: Use strict United States, age 40 plus, mobile and iOS controls with Advantage Plus audience. Treat relevant interests only as suggestions when Meta returns them; stay broad rather than force an undersized interest audience.
small_market_delivery_plan.group_policy: Named Facebook group membership is not targetable. Use permission-first organic resource posts and eligible public partnership ads only.
small_market_delivery_plan.objective_policy: Use Traffic optimized for link clicks until verified app-install or subscription events are available through an eligible SDK or measurement partner.

base.condition: Authorized one-time seven-day base pilot using an ad-set daily budget, never a lifetime-budget delivery path; cold only, with warm held at zero.

authorized_partner.condition: Blocked unless the partner gate passes and an explicit authorized total is reallocated without increasing it.

optional_inventory.name: facebook_groups_feed
optional_inventory.policy: Enable only if selectable for this objective and compatible with the assigned asset. It is general inventory and must never be represented as targeting a named group.

targeting.suggestion_policy: Use only suggestions returned as eligible by the live Meta account. If unavailable or undersized, remove suggestions and remain broad under the strict controls above. Do not substitute Army, Navy, veteran, or military-history interests.

ad_sets.name: AS2_Warm_MetaEngagers
ad_sets.activation_condition: Remain PAUSED until the combined eligible audience is ready and total campaign reach is approximately 1000 or greater.

optional_partner_ad_set.name: AS3_PublicPartner
creation_gate: Content is public and eligible for partnership ads.
A valid partnership-ad code or equivalent permission is supplied.
The partner allocation is removed from the cold allocation before this ad set is created.
The resulting total does not exceed the separately approved lifetime cap.
optional_partner_ad_set.targeting: Use AS1 strict geo, age, language, device, and iOS controls; do not derive an audience from private group membership.
